title: Interactive export SLAs and pricing preview for frequent usage snapshots
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define a triage and delivery playbook for recurring high-frequency usage snapshot exports that includes: SLA lane definitions (real-time, daily, weekly), an interactive sample preview feature to let tenants validate columns and row-sampling before export, and a live cost/projection calculator surfaced in the Console to set expectations and gating.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form fieldset added to Console export request UI capturing frequency, retention window, preferred SLA lane, and sample criteria.
3 SLA lanes defined with target delivery windows, cost multipliers, and eligibility rules for tenant size.
Interactive sample-preview endpoint (read-only) returns first N rows and schema with implicit PII redaction rules.
Cost projection shown to users with tokenized/row cost breakdown and monthly projection based on selection.
Backend export job scheduler supports priority lanes and emits telemetry to Console for SLA adherence.
Documentation and runbook completed, including escalation path for missed SLA and quota bump flows.
updates: 2026-03-10 - Draft created by Asha with initial problem statement and proposed scope.
2026-03-11 - Sync with Design (Maya Li) - initial wireframes for interactive sample preview and cost calculator; requests simpler schema display and 'anonymize sample' toggle.

2026-03-12 - Eng feasibility session with Runtime/Infra (lead: Diego Ramos) - identified need for read-replica snapshot endpoint and approximate cost estimation model. Estimated infra work: 3 sprint slices.
2026-03-13 - PM review: tightened acceptance criteria to include explicit telemetry events and sample row-limit default of 100.
2026-03-13 - Decided to gate real-time SLA lane to Dedicated customers for first iteration.
decisions: Ship interactive sample preview as read-only API to avoid data leakage risk; anonymize default.
Real-time SLA lane initially restricted to Dedicated customers to limit capacity impact.
Cost projection will use historical per-row tokenization model and display conservative upper bound.
next_steps: Finalize intake form fields and validation rules with Design by 2026-03-17.
Engineering to provide implementation plan and a high-level schema for sample-preview API by 2026-03-20.
Create a telemetry contract for SLA adherence and cost anomalies before first dev PR.
Draft customer-facing FAQ and pricing note for enterprise sales to use in onboarding.
